title: fix: remove the timeout for all Decisions models
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Removed the local request deadline from the shared Decisions adapter, so it no longer times out requests for any Decisions model or fallback that uses it. The abort controller, timer cleanup, and obsolete signal assertion were removed; upstream errors and usage validation remain intact. Native, chat, and streaming requests were checked across Jev, Kev, Span, and Liquid D1, including usage and billing.
